question: What does it mean when a stock has a MACD crossover, and can you show me a couple that just had a bullish one?

q: MACD line crossing above signal line

tools_called.result_summary: Resolved: pattern='crossover_up', a='macd_line', b='macd_signal'. Both queries converged on crossover_up + macd_line/macd_signal. Description: MACD line (diff of two EMAs) crossing above the signal line (EMA of the MACD) = bullish momentum shift.

Returned 59 stocks with recent bullish MACD crossover. Examples: 097950.KO (CJ Cheiljedang, cross 2026-08-28, macd_line -1441 crossed above signal -1568), MBG.SW / Mercedes-Benz (cross 2026-08-28, strength 1.0, RSI 58.6). Signal confirmed as macd_x_signal_up in results.
